title: Breathing changes
hook: A life cycle may involve different gas-exchange surfaces.

knows: Animals have body structures and interact with their surroundings.
doesNotKnow: The schematic contrasts tadpole gills in water with adult lungs in air. Frog skin can also participate in gas exchange, and timing and structures vary across amphibians.

misconception: The observed arrangement has a different effect than the one shown.
objective: In a typical frog life cycle, which structure is associated with an adult frog breathing air?
